searchText: No Portal call today, there is a conflicting EF meeting Notes from that meeting: the Ethereum Foundation has dropped all direct support for Portal. Almost all of us who were full-time on Portal are no longer working at the EF. I have no idea if any of the technology might survive, but it is literally no longer my job 😆
